# ADR-3219: AWS network: 0.0.0.0/0 SSH ingress for security group 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Open SSH is routinely scanned and exploited.

## Decision

Security groups MUST NOT allow a 0.0.0.0/0 SSH ingress for security group 3 (AWS-network-3).

## Consequences

Admin access uses SSM or tightly scoped CIDRs.
